home.title: All your clients in one cozy place
home.lead: A simple, friendly platform for freelancers: keep contacts, take notes and see where every collaboration stands. No clutter, so more time is left for the work that matters.
home.heroAlt: A smiling freelancer working on a laptop by a window with an autumn view
home.eveningAlt: A man working on a laptop, with a client list from the CRM shown next to him
home.aboutText: Freelancing often starts with scattered notes, emails and bookmarks. This platform gathers everything you need to work with clients in one place: who they are, what their company does, what you agreed on and where the collaboration stands. It is a calm workspace with no complicated settings, equally comfortable on a computer and on a phone.

features.title: Clients at hand
features.text: Each client's name, company, email and notes live in a single list, and a client card opens with one click.

features.title: Clear stages
features.text: Every client has a status: lead, active or archived. You can see at a glance who you are working with right now.

features.title: Private access
features.text: The workspace opens once an administrator approves your application, which keeps the platform tidy and secure.

features.title: Your language and theme
features.text: Ukrainian, English, Polish and Czech, a light and a dark theme, and a layout that works well on a phone.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Create an account: all you need is a name, an email and a password.

steps.title: Wait for approval
steps.text: An administrator reviews your application and opens access to the workspace.

steps.title: Work with clients
steps.text: Once approved, you get the client list and cards with all the details.

home.closingText: Submit your application, it takes a minute. As soon as it is approved, your workspace is ready.

items.title: Commercial proposal
items.description: An email to the client: what you will do, when and for how much.
items.text:
Subject: Proposal: [project name]

Hello [client name],

Thank you for your interest in working together. Here is a short description of what I propose.

Task
[One or two sentences: what needs to be done and why]

What is included
- [item 1]
- [item 2]
- [item 3]
- [number] rounds of revisions

Timeline
Start: [date]. Delivery: [date]. The timeline depends on when I receive your materials and answers.

Price
[amount] [currency]. Payment: [for example, 50% upfront and 50% on delivery].

What is not included
[For example: hosting, copywriting, extra pages. These are quoted separately.]

This proposal is valid until [date]. If everything looks good, let me know and I will send the contract and an invoice.

Best regards,
[your name]
[contacts]

items.title: Client brief
items.description: Questions to answer before the work starts.
items.text:
Project brief: [name]

Please answer the questions below. Short answers are fine.

1. About you and your business
- Company name and field: 
- How you differ from competitors: 

2. About the project
- What problem the result should solve: 
- Who the target audience is: 
- Examples you like (links): 
- Examples you dislike, and why: 

3. Materials
- Logo, brand colors, fonts (yes / no): 
- Texts and photos (you provide / need help): 

4. Timeline and budget
- Desired completion date: 
- Approximate budget: 

5. How we work
- Who on your side makes decisions and approves the result: 
- Preferred way to communicate: 

Thank you! After your answers I will send a proposal with the timeline and price.

items.title: Service agreement (simplified)
items.description: The main points of an agreement between contractor and client.
items.text:
SERVICE AGREEMENT No. [number]

[city], [date]

Contractor: [full name], [details or ID].
Client: [full name or company], [details].

1. Subject
The Contractor performs the following work for the Client: [description]. Scope: [list or reference to the proposal].

2. Timeline
Start: [date]. Delivery: [date]. The timeline moves by the length of any delay in the Client's materials or answers.

3. Price and payment
Price: [amount] [currency]. Payment: [for example, 50% upfront, 50% on delivery] within [number] days.

4. Revisions
The price includes [number] rounds of revisions within the agreed task. Extra revisions and new requirements are paid separately.

5. Rights to the result
After full payment the Client receives the right to use the result as follows: [describe]. The Contractor may show the work in a portfolio unless agreed otherwise.

6. Confidentiality
The parties will not disclose each other's confidential information received during the work.

7. Liability and termination
The parties are liable under applicable law. Either party may terminate the agreement with [number] days' written notice. Work completed up to that point is paid for.

8. Signatures
Contractor: ____________  Client: ____________

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.lead: A free trial first, then simple monthly payment. No hidden fees.
subscription.trialText: Starts as soon as the administrator approves your request. Every feature is available from day one.
subscription.paidText: Pay only for the months you need. Extend for a month, three months or a year.
included: A dated journal of notes for every client
Only you can see your data
Interface in four languages, light and dark theme

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Create an account and wait for your request to be approved.

steps.title: Free trial
steps.text: After approval you get access to the CRM for a free trial period.

steps.title: Invoice
steps.text: When the term is running out, press "Request an invoice" on this page.

steps.title: Payment
steps.text: The administrator sends an invoice to your email. After you pay by card transfer, access is extended.

subscription.paymentNote: Payment is a transfer to a card against an invoice that is sent to you personally. No card details are entered on the website.
